 SHOPEE CUP™ GROUP A: HO CHI MINH CITY POLICE FC 1-0 BURIRAM UNITED FC 
 Nov 18 2026
 -->
 -->
 Nguyễn Thái Quốc Cường hit a stunning winner two minutes from time as ASEAN Club Championship Shopee Cup™ debutants Ho Chi Minh City Police FC registered a 1-0 victory over champions Buriram United FC in Group A in Ho Chi Minh City on Wednesday.
 Thái Quốc Cường curled an unstoppable right-footed strike into the top corner of Neil Etheridge’s goal to secure Ho Chi Minh City Police’s first win in the competition while Buriram United remained winless after two rounds of matches.
 The goal came after the home side soaked up increasing pressure from the Raúl Caneda-coached title holders, who were unable to find a way past Ho Chi Minh City Police goalkeeper Patrik Lê Giang.
 Buriram United started positively with Thanakrit Chotmuangpak’s cross from the left causing panic in the home defence while Toni Moya flashed a ninth minute strike from distance just wide of Lê Giang’s right post.
 It was Sasalak Haiprakhon’s incisive pass from wide on the left that unlocked the Ho Chi Minh City Police defence in the 26th minute, the ball reaching Alexandru Tudorie and his deft flick found Goran Čaušić, but his attempt was blocked at close range by an alert Lê Giang.
 With eight minutes left in the half the home side carved out their first genuine sight of goal.
 Olaha Mạnh Đức’s trickery on the edge of the penalty area saw the Nigeria-born Vietnam international create enough space to shoot towards goal, but Etheridge was equal to the test, diving to his right to gather.
 Čaušić could only warm Lê Giang’s hands with his shot from 18 yards out at the start of the second half while Mạnh Đức’s attempt moments later flew across the face of goal, although the assistant referee had raised his flag for offside.
 Sasalak’s effort from distance was well over the bar in the 61st minute while Stefan Schimmer was inches away from putting Buriram United in front but his desperate dive to meet Wanderson’s centre from the left saw the forward narrowly glance his header wide.
 Lê Giang then pulled off a crucial reflex save in the 70th minute to frustrate Sebas Moyano when the Spaniard cut inside from the right flank and power a shot towards goal that the home goalkeeper palmed onto his own post before seeing the ball hacked clear.
 And with two minutes remaining the winner arrived for Arthur Diles’ side. 
 Phan Văn Đức had seen his initial effort blocked at close range by Etheridge but there was nothing the visiting goalkeeper could do when the rebound fell to Thái Quốc Cường and he curled a stunning winner into the top corner.
 Shopee Star of the Match - Patrik Le Giang (#1), Ho Chi Minh City Police FC
